summary: The Staff system manages various staff-related functionalities including staff information management, search and retrieval of staff details, departmental roles, and policies. It covers functionalities such as managing contact information, roles, and policies associated with staff, and addresses various use cases including searches by department, program, and roles. It also handles staff activation, deactivation, and updates.
purpose: The purpose of the Staff system is to manage the organizational and operational aspects of staff members, including their personal information, roles, and responsibilities within the organization. It facilitates the administration of staff-related processes such as updates, role assignments, and retrieval of specific staff data based on complex criteria.

workflows.name: Staff Information Update
steps: Retrieve current session and staff details.
Return confirmation of update or errors encountered.

workflows.name: Staff Search by Department
steps: Specify department ID and other criteria.
Execute stored procedure to retrieve staff data.
Read and format data from database.
Return list of staff matching criteria.

workflows.name: Staff Activation
steps: Specify staff ID to be activated.
Execute stored procedure to activate staff in the database.
Return confirmation of activation or error messages.

workflows.name: Staff Deactivation
steps: Specify staff ID and reason for deactivation.
Execute stored procedure to deactivate staff in the database.
Return confirmation of deactivation or error messages.

business_rules: Staff must have a valid department assigned.
Course Leaders must also be instructors.
Phone numbers must be valid if provided.
Email addresses must be valid if provided.
validations: Ensure first and last names are specified.
Validate phone, fax, and email format.

calculations.name: Phone Number Area Code
calculations.description: Separate the area code from the rest of the phone number.

calculations.name: Last Login Date Formatting
calculations.description: Format the last login date in a short date format or indicate 'Never' if not applicable.

conditions: Only system administrators can see all details unless explicitly allowed.
Contact information may be hidden unless user has edit permissions.
system_behavior: Cache staff information temporarily to reduce database calls.
Automatically append agency name to department if searching all agencies.
If hiding contact info, clear sensitive fields unless exceptions apply.
dependencies: HSPnet framework for session and database operations.
UI components for name and phone formatting.
exceptions: Invalid input data causing validation errors.
Attempts to update non-existent staff records.
